name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis → explore → design) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → optional /spec:design (mock-bound, deterministic fidelity gates) → /spec:build (direct Sonnet worker dispatch per layer wave, executed red-check) → /spec:review (spec-review-driver.js stepped, driver-stepped: deterministic legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros; verdict derived by verdict.js) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.39.2 — workflow scripts return to review scope (specs/20260825/05-workflow-scripts-in-review-scope.md): this repo's `pipelineOwnedPaths` entry for `spec/workflows/wf-*.js` is deleted. It was written for `build-workflows.js`'s generated output; that generator, its gate step, and the workflows build layer were all removed in `61e2e5a` (2026-08-17) and the exclusion outlived them, hiding an unplanned edit to a frozen workflow script from scope-reconcile and pruning the file from collision-closure's literals leg — the blind spot 7.37.1 worked around with an enumerated-file test. Now an out-of-plan edit to `wf-research.js`/`wf-enforce.js` is a visible review finding and the literals leg can see inside them; the enumerated sweep stays as a standing gate. Three new tests exercise the repo's real config through the real entrypoints; the host-declared `pipelineOwnedPaths` mechanism is unchanged and remains fully honored. 7.39.1 — review-round repairs to the genesis driver (specs/20260825/04-genesis-driver.md, review 2026-08-26). `runShell` no longer pipes the `scaffoldCommand`/`gateCommand` child through `spawnSync`'s default 1 MiB `maxBuffer` — it streams straight to `.claude/genesis/scaffold.log`/`gate.log` via the log fd, so a real scaffold (`create-next-app` plus an install) is no longer SIGTERM'd mid-run with an unclearable remedy; `runChild`'s fail-closed semantics are unchanged. `logTail`'s excerpt is now bounded in bytes (`LOGTAIL_MAX_BYTES`), not lines, with a `… truncated, full log at <path> …` marker attached after the line slice — a gate emitting one unbroken multi-megabyte line can no longer overflow a caller capturing the driver's own stdout. The MENUS re-print names the options `registry-check.js` dropped for currency instead of pointing at the menu file (D4). `--state` is a genuine read-only peek: it never executes the scaffold or gate command, and may report the transient `SCAFFOLD`/`GATE` states. The marketplace listing no longer advertises the retired architect command, and its stale-name sweep is now a repo-wide walk minus a justified waive-list rather than an enumerated file list. 7.39.0 — the genesis architect stage becomes driver-stepped (specs/20260825/04-genesis-driver.md). New `spec/scripts/genesis-driver.js` (`spec-paths genesis-driver`) derives state from `.claude/genesis/status.json` (schemaVersion 2, now carrying `marks`, `menus`, `scaffold`, `zeroDayGate`) plus the artifacts actually on disk on every invocation, executes every deterministic step itself (the coverage-audit gate, the registry check per menu, the decision-record closure check, the scaffold command, the zero-day gate, the roadmap closure check), and prints only the one step needing this session's judgment. `/spec:genesis-architect` is deleted; the new `/spec:genesis` command loops on the driver until `HANDOFF`. Every accepted `--mark` prints a checkpoint line (`✅ checkpoint — genesis state saved (<prev> → <next>); safe to /clear and re-run /spec:genesis`), so a full genesis run is safe across as many `/clear`s as it needs. `/spec:genesis-explore` and `/spec:genesis-design` are unchanged except for the predecessor's new name.
